[LGRA.9.8.2] **The read function** — `cached(key)` reads
external state. It is an expression, not an action; it may
appear **only** as the entire RHS of a `let` binding.
Anywhere else (an action kwarg, an interpolation segment,
embedded inside another expression) is a compile error.

One exception, and only one: **`cached()` may also appear
inside a `where` clause**, because the cache is read-only
while patterns are being evaluated, so the value is stable
for the duration of an activation ([LSTO.4.3.1a]).

**`cached(key)` is the only read function.** A call naming
any other function is refused by [LGRA.9.8.11]'s closed
built-in set.
